semantics: rrule.js (jkbrzt/rrule, a JavaScript port of python-dateutil) test/rrule.test.ts testRecurring(msg, rule | {rrule, method, args}, expected). new RRule({...}) options were mapped to RRULE text like the dateutil source (freq, interval, count, until, wkst, bysetpos, bymonth, bymonthday, byyearday, byweekno, byweekday (RRule.TU.nth(-1) -> -1TU), byhour, byminute, bysecond, byeaster -> BYEASTER + extensions). rrule.js datetime(y,m,d,h,mi,s) and parse('YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS') build UTC JS Dates, so every value here carries a Z suffix. Like dateutil, DTSTART is NOT emitted unless it matches the rule (include_dtstart=false). method 'all' -> full list; 'between'(a, b, inc) -> between (exclusive unless inc); 'after'(dt, inc) -> between.start + limit 1. The upstream assertDatesEqual() only checks the length when more than one date is expected, so cases with a single expected date and method 'all' get limit=1 (only the first instance is compared), and cases with no expected dates are skipped (nothing is asserted). Most cases duplicate dateutil's suite.
